title: Google AdSense reusable components and global content-area rendering

requirements.summary: Add reusable AdSense script-loader and ad slot React components with safe, repeatable rendering behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A reusable component exists to load the AdSense script once using: <script async src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-8182684208705293" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>.
A reusable AdSlot component exists that can be placed multiple times without crashing the app (guards against missing window.adsbygoogle and multiple pushes).
No backend changes are required for these components.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable AdSenseScript component that injects the provided AdSense script into the document body (not head) and guarantees it is loaded only once per browser page load (e.g., module-level singleton/flag and DOM id check).

Create a reusable AdSlot component that renders an <ins class="adsbygoogle"> with configurable props (ad client, slot id, format, responsive, etc.) and safely triggers rendering (guards for missing window, missing adsbygoogle, try/catch around push, and prevents duplicate push per mount).

Create a small wrapper component intended for layout usage that composes AdSenseScript + one or more AdSlot placements and includes a safe no-op/disabled path when slot configuration is absent to avoid runtime errors while still keeping the insertion point in the <main> content flow.

requirements.summary: Render AdSense globally inside the app’s <main> content area for all sections and for the referral redirect route without duplicating script loads.
acceptanceCriteria: When navigating between sections (home/tasks/wallet/profile), the ad rendering remains within the main scrollable content area (inside the app layout’s <main>).
When visiting the referral redirect route (currentSection starting with "r/"), the page still includes the content-area ad insertion without interfering with redirect behavior.
The AdSense script is not duplicated on navigation; it is loaded once per browser page load.

file_operations.description: Insert GlobalContentAds inside the existing <main> element so ads are part of the main scrollable content flow across all standard sections (home/tasks/wallet/profile), and ensure placement does not interfere with existing layout padding/scroll behavior.

Wrap the referral redirect UI in a <main>-based content container and include GlobalContentAds within that main flow so the referral route also gets content-area ad insertion while preserving existing redirect behavior and states.

Ensure the referral redirect rendering path still results in ads being rendered within a <main> content flow (via the ReferralRedirect changes) and confirm no additional AdSense script duplication occurs during section navigation.
